methods.description: Identify what responses record: counted/measured amounts are numerical, names/descriptions/groups categorical. Apply to named variables and survey questions rather than sample size or display type.
Digits or decimals alone do not classify data; inspect whether the recorded value identifies a category or records a counted/measured amount. Explain number-coded categorical choices.
